messages:
maria: Quick question — dashboard is showing a cluster of requests where auth routing falls back to projectless attribution for org-scoped API keys. Not sure if this is sampling noise or a real routing mismatch. Anyone seen this today?

akshay: saw a blip around 10:14 UTC, same behavior. quota_id was missing in the logs for ~2% of requests.

jamie: is this the new sampling rollout? we pushed the sampling change to 2% yesterday. could be the sampler edge-case.

maria: we're on sampling v2 (header-based). But some requests are hitting legacy path. snippet from the proxy logs: 
```
INFO auth-router: credential=org:12345 key=sha256:abcd fallback=projectless reason=missing_project_claim route=fast-path
```

lina: that `missing_project_claim` looks like the token exchange didn't attach `x-project` header. Are these coming from the same ingress?

akshay: different ingresses. I grep'd for the request-id pattern — both GCP and Dedicated pools. hop-count shows exchange proxy returned 502 a few ms earlier.

maria: hm. If proxy 502 then the auth-exchange may not have augmented the token, so downstream treats as projectless. But why only on sampled requests?

jamie: possible race: sampler inline modifies routing policy and short-circuits to the new fast-path that expects `exchange` to be synchronous. if exchange occasionally times out, the request still goes through. normal path retries, fast-path doesn't.

lina: can we confirm by correlating `sampler=true` header with `exchange_timeout` in traces? I can add a quick trace query.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary sampling rollout v2 -> 10% targets applied to rollout-group alpha at 2025-11-03T09:00:12Z :rocket:

akshay: that timestamp aligns. alpha group hits both pools. I think the fast-path assumption is the culprit.

maria: proposals: 1) make fast-path tolerant (fall back to retry exchange synchronously), 2) change sampler to run post-exchange, or 3) tighten timeout/retry on exchange for sampled flow. Thoughts?

jamie: 1 is safest short-term. Implement quick sync retry when project claim missing, and emit a metric `auth.fastpath.missing_project_claim` so product/ops can track.

lina: agree. product wants to avoid double-counting tokens for quota. need to ensure fallback doesn't create duplicate billing attribution. maybe mark retried requests with `x-auth-retry:1`.

akshay: /me will add metric and `x-auth-retry`. Also will spike a non-production canary with sync retry enabled.

maria: can someone sketch the dashboard tiles we need? product asked for telemetry: percent of fallback, percent of sampled requests with missing_claim, distribution by ingress region.

jamie: minimal dashboard: timeseries of `auth.fastpath.missing_project_claim` (p50/p95), a breakdown by ingress, and a cross-chart showing `exchange.latency` vs `fallback_rate`. Also a table listing top 10 clients by occurrences.

maria: perfect. Lina, can you add a log-based alert: if fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m -> page oncall? we want a low-threshold to catch regressions during rollout.

lina: yep. I'll create alert and dashboard panel.

akshay: timeline: I'll open a quick PR for sync-retry + header flag tonight. Jamie can review tomorrow morning. Then we can flip the canary to guarded mode for alpha.

maria: cool. Also add a note in the console rollout doc that sampler depends on exchange behavior; we should document the `x-auth-retry` header and billing implications. product was surprised.

jamie: will add doc blurb and a migration note for Dedicated pools.

maria: thanks all. if we see anything weird after change, tag me and @sre-oncall. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: alert created: auth-fastpath-fallback-rate > 0.5% for 5m — suppressed for alpha group during maintenance.

akshay: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-router/pull/381 — sync retry + metric. comments welcome.

maria: inspected PR, left two nit comments. once green, let's merge and flip alpha to guarded.

lina: dashboard + alert created: https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts/auth-fallback-panel (panels: missing_claim, exchange_latency, ingress_breakdown).

jamie: nice. i'll land docs after the PR merges.

maria: closing loop: we'll monitor for 24h post-merge and re-evaluate sampling rollout plan. thanks!
